# Overnight oats

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Per serving** | 440 kcal · 30 g P · 62 g C · 8 g F |
| **Slot** | breakfast |
| **Prep** | assemble · 5 min · serves 1 |
| **Nutrition** | estimated |
| **Status** | active |

## Ingredients
- 60 g rolled oats
- 200 ml semi-skimmed milk
- 150 g 0% greek yoghurt
- 1 tsp honey
<!-- coach:end card overnight-oats -->

## Method
1. Stir everything together in a jar.
2. Chill overnight.
